qualified_matrix.engine: distribution-provided Tesseract 5.x (5.3.4 observed locally; exact CI version recorded by the workflow)

execution_baseline.security_boundary: Private temporary directories and bounded child processes are implemented; no general-purpose security sandbox is claimed

renderer_and_decoder.selection: PDFium for PDF rasterization and Pillow for TIFF/image decoding

components.license: Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause, plus dependency licenses shipped in the wheel

components.delivery: contained in the external pypdfium2 Linux wheel, not in a Provelume artifact

renderer_and_decoder.native_dependency_notices: The external wheels retain their own license directories; no wheel or native library is copied into Provelume distributions

evaluated_alternatives.reason: PDF orchestrator rather than the engine seam; requires Tesseract and Ghostscript, whose AGPL-3.0 redistribution and service obligations need a separate decision
large ML runtime and model supply chain; official pipelines can obtain models from remote model sources
PyTorch runtime and language models that are automatically downloaded unless separately staged

upstream_components.purpose: image decoding and processing used by Tesseract
optional PNG, JPEG and TIFF decoding selected by a future pinned Leptonica build
upstream_components.gate: Every selected codec requires an exact version, source, license, digest and SBOM entry before redistribution

base_wheel.behavior: Contract, local adapter code, schema and disabled configuration; no native OCR component

sdist.behavior: Includes source contract and packaging metadata, never third-party OCR binaries

windows_installer.supported_model: Explicit external local installation only; no offline Windows payload is delivered or qualified in S02
windows_installer.future_payload_gate: Pinned source build, exact manifest and digests, license files, notices, SBOM, clean-room scan and offline installation test

platforms.engine_evidence: Real-component CI executes Tesseract, pypdfium2/PDFium, Pillow and the external eng pack
Upstream documents Homebrew/MacPorts installation; no S02 real-component CI evidence
Upstream/Homebrew distribution is external; no S02 real-component CI evidence

redistribution.provelume_license_compatibility: Compatible as an aggregate when third-party licenses and notices remain attached; Provelume's PolyForm/Commercial terms do not replace them
required_before_bundle: Copy Apache-2.0 terms for Tesseract and every redistributed tessdata pack
Preserve applicable upstream NOTICE and attribution material
Copy the Leptonica BSD-2-Clause copyright and license text
Inventory every linked codec and runtime library with exact source, version, license and digest
Add all components and language packs to release manifest and CycloneDX SBOM
Publish checksums and independently verify an offline install with networking denied

absence_behavior.disabled: Report ocr_disabled without probing an adapter or engine
absence_behavior.adapter_missing: Report ocr_adapter_unavailable; do not install or download anything
absence_behavior.engine_missing: Report ocr_engine_unavailable; do not invoke a remote service
absence_behavior.renderer_missing: Report ocr_renderer_unavailable; do not install a renderer or decoder
absence_behavior.version_incompatible: Report ocr_version_incompatible and require an explicit local replacement
absence_behavior.language_pack_missing: Report ocr_language_pack_missing with the missing explicit pack IDs; do not download them
absence_behavior.all_failures: Preserve the Original and canonical knowledge; derived OCR state may be removed or rebuilt
